source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: This Hexmark Destroyer can shoot back once each turn. Enemy shooting in the opponent’s [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) triggers the option if it targets one of your **NECRONS** units no farther than 3″ from the Destroyer. Wait for the enemy to finish shooting. Then fire as you would in your own [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), targeting the attacker if eligible.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
